entry.title: The deadline is today
entry.content: Everybody has finished their tasks and somehow I’ve been nominated group leader. I have looked over the document and had to reformat everything, and change some inconsistensies between peoples work since for some reason they didn’t want to work off of the original pitch document. I’ve also spent the past 24 hours chasing people up about parts of the document that nobody had started since there was nobody assigned to them and then someone nominated me to write the conclusion, and someone else wasn’t bothered to make the pitch video so I now also have to rewrite the script and make that myself. I also somehow managed to fix my Gamecube’s input last night so at least I have that to look forward to after this. I’m aalso very much hoping the blog is allowed to be informal like this since it’s only a blog but I’m probably wrong but oh welllll.💯
